rollback.limit: Version 1.0 Roadmap writes use new lifecycle statuses and readiness/health events that v0.12.1 cannot interpret faithfully. Stop writers and restore a coherent pre-upgrade backup of both stores, roster, controls and release selection with its matching code. Preserve post-upgrade stores and reconcile post-backup writes separately; code-only rollback does not retain them safely.

notes: Back up before any command from this release opens the installation. Schema additions happen on open; the optional roadmap-migrate r46 row conversion writes only with --apply, and archived rows need installation-owned judgments. New code reads legacy rows and events. Automated release writes require --ticket <record-id>. This declaration deliberately names no release directory because the consumer chooses that name. See INSTALLATIONS.md, Upgrading from v0.12.1 to v1.0.0.
